name: What is small-group training?
description: Small-group training provides personalized coaching for 2-6 participants, blending individual attention with group motivation.

acceptedAnswer.text: Small-group training at Cave Training offers personalized coaching in a supportive group setting, typically with 2-6 participants. It combines the individualized attention of personal training with the dynamic energy and cost-effectiveness of group fitness. This format allows coaches to provide specific feedback and modifications for each individual, ensuring proper form and maximizing results while building a sense of community among participants.
